_meta.warning: content/advocacy.json → progress[] currently asserts 'Bill 142', 'Bill 87', a 'Win — Mar 2025' (patient seat on the EAP committee) and a 'Win — Nov 2025' (Northern Centre of Expertise pilot). None of these are corroborated by the account or by any source found. Claimed legislative wins with dates should not ship unverified. The real, citable items are below.

time to diagnosis in the Markus family's case

legislation.title: Rare Disease Strategy Act, 2023
legislation.longTitle: An Act to amend the Health Protection and Promotion Act to implement the recommendations of the Rare Diseases Working Group Report
legislation.status: First Reading carried, June 7 2023 — no subsequent readings
legislation.proposes: Requires Ontario to implement the recommendations of the Rare Diseases Working Group Report (March 10, 2017) as soon as is practicable, and to publish progress updates every six months.
legislation.relevance: Directly on point for the 'Provincial Rare Disease Strategy' goal, and co-sponsor France Gélinas spoke at the org's own breakfast. This is a real bill the progress tracker could cite instead of the invented 'Bill 142'.
